offering_description.value: Builds, resurfaces and repairs roads for transportation agencies, municipalities and private developers. It uses asphalt from its own plants and aggregates from its quarries in construction projects and sells paving materials to other contractors.

primary_products.value: hot-mix asphalt; construction aggregates; liquid asphalt cement

primary_services.value: roadway construction and reconstruction; asphalt paving and resurfacing; site development; drainage and utility installation

customer_segment.value: B2G: state transportation departments, municipalities and other public infrastructure agencies; B2B: general contractors, paving contractors and commercial and residential developers

end_markets.value: highways and local roads; airports; commercial development; residential development

revenue_model.value: project or contract: road construction, paving, resurfacing and site development projects; product sales: asphalt and aggregates sold to outside contractors

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses paving materials and equipment to build and resurface roads for agencies and developers; OEM / manufacturer: combines aggregates and asphalt binder to make hot-mix asphalt for its paving crews and outside contractors; raw materials: extracts and processes stone, sand and gravel for its plants and construction customers; asset operator: runs asphalt plants, quarries and binder terminals that supply its paving crews and other contractors
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; raw materials; asset operator

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern United States and Texas

specialization.value: related lines: road construction, asphalt paving, site development, asphalt production and aggregate mining

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: public bids, private construction contracts and direct materials orders; own locations: asphalt plants and quarries serving local construction customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental permits for asphalt plants and quarries, OSHA and mine safety rules, and state transportation specifications

notes: The full current list of operating states is uncertain.
